description: Generates or edits video with audio through Gemini Omni Flash interactions. Length (3-10s) is set in the prompt; 360p to 4k.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

input.description: Prompt for the clip. State the length (3-10s) in the prompt itself; there is no duration field.

previous_interaction_id.description: Id of an earlier interaction to continue, for multi-turn editing of the clip it produced.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Billing is per output video token, so a higher resolution costs proportionally more; 360p is the draft tier.
